premise.coldViewerWhyCare: An ordinary magnesium bottle may have an unexpected B6 ingredient and the combined amounts can matter
premise.viewerQuestion: Could hidden vitamin B6 in multiple supplements cause nerve problems?
premise.earlyPayoff: Some common supplements contain B6 and excessive supplemental exposure is linked to neuropathy

beats.narration: Your magnesium supplement might contain a vitamin that can damage nerves.
beats.visualPurpose: Vitamin label transforms into an illustrated nerve signal.
beats.visualAction: magnesium supplement revealed as containing B6

beats.narration: It's vitamin B6. We need some, but too much from supplements can cause tingling or numbness in hands and feet.
beats.visualPurpose: Essential vitamin appears beside a symbolic sensory nerve signal.
beats.visualAction: neutral nerve signal changes to broken signal with SYMBOLIC annotation

beats.narration: Some multivitamins, B complexes, magnesium and zinc products contain B6. Using several can quietly stack your total intake.
beats.visualPurpose: Four separate illustrative product silhouettes reveal B6 labels.
beats.visualAction: four additive exposure traces converge with no invented amounts

beats.narration: Australia's medicines regulator has received reports involving people using multiple B6 containing supplements.
beats.visualPurpose: Regulator report and supplement stack side by side.
beats.visualAction: one regulator report sheet emerges, marked spontaneous reports

beats.narration: These reports can't tell us how common the problem is, and these symptoms have other possible causes.
beats.visualPurpose: Observation/report card divided from population risk counter.
beats.visualAction: incidence dial stays unknown rather than displaying fabricated rate

beats.narration: Check every label for vitamin B6 or pyridoxine. If tingling or numbness develops, stop the supplements and seek medical advice.
beats.visualPurpose: Clear illustrated Supplement Facts label followed by medical-help guidance.
beats.visualAction: pyridoxine text highlighted, then advice line appears

beats.visualPurpose: Sources: NIH ODS and TGA; PMID 37447150.
